name: Autopilot Monitor
description: Autopilot Monitor provides real-time visibility into Windows Autopilot enrollments with live telemetry, intelligent diagnostics, and automated troubleshooting. It includes a bootstrap script deployed via Intune, a lightweight Monitoring Agent, a Backend API (Azure Functions), and a Next.js web dashboard for fleet analytics. It tracks enrollment phases, runs customizable analyze rules, collects diagnostics, and notifies teams to accelerate issue resolution.
author: Oliver Kieselbach

securityCheck.aiSummary: The code is a standard helper for obtaining a temporary Azure Storage access token via the Azure CLI and returning it as part of a header dictionary. No hardcoded secrets or obfuscated code are present. The primary security concern is potential token leakage through outputs/logs since the Authorization header is returned and could be captured by logs or telemetry. Ensure proper log redaction and consider options to minimize token exposure (e.g., performing calls within the module and avoiding emitting the header, or redacting the token in any captured logs).
